findings.reason: This existing audit-only bootstrap installs exact npm 10.9.8 with lifecycle scripts disabled. It is version-pinned, not integrity-locked; the low-severity package-resolution risk is retained in this lint-only change. No application dependency or release job is installed by this step.

The labeler intentionally uses pull_request_target for its label-write token. It only reads the event title and number through environment variables, derives fixed label names, and calls the GitHub labels API. It never checks out or executes pull-request code. The whole workflow hash binds that safety argument, including every step, not just the trigger.

This informational, low-confidence finding interpolates the Pages URL from the pinned deploy-pages action, not pull-request content. Readback only runs on workflow_dispatch after the Pages deployment. This lane preserves publication and readback behavior; any change to the complete workflow requires fresh review.
